basic_profile.bio: A sci-fi enthusiast and casual binge-watcher, I've been navigating the Reddit universe for nearly a decade. Originally from the outskirts of Toronto, I work as a software developer during the day and indulge in my love for science fiction and history by night. When I'm not coding, I'm either exploring the latest advancements in 3D graphics or discussing the finer points of historical dramas like 'Ertugrul'. I'm a devoted pet parent to a fluffy Pomeranian named Gizmo. My online hours are typically in the evenings and weekends, when I have the time to unwind and engage with fellow fans. Currently single, I enjoy the flexibility of being able to focus on my hobbies and career.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and a minor in History, my knowledge base is a mix of formal education and self-directed learning. My passion for programming started in high school and has only grown with my career in software development. I've also taken several online courses in 3D modeling and animation, which complements my interest in the 3DMA subreddit.
